interested in

  • CURIE: gmeow:interestedIn
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/interestedIn
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/cognition
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

A motivational orientation of an agent toward a subject — sustained interest that makes the subject worth attending to. An attentional/affective pull, NOT a teleology:Desire (a wanted goal); the boundary is documented, never an axiom (Principle 9). Whose interest it is rides gmeow:accordingTo on the statement.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Agent -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:interestedIn from gmeow:Agent to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Agent, gmeow:Entity

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for an agent's sustained motivational orientation toward a subject — durable interest that makes the subject worth attending to, broader than the momentary focus of gmeow:attendsTo.

Avoid when

  • Avoid using it for a wanted goal (that is the teleology slice — interest is an affective pull, not a conative mode, never bridged by axiom, Principle 9); when the interest is specifically knowledge-seeking, use the narrower gmeow:curiousAbout.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:interestedIn from agent to subject (gmeow:curiousAbout specializes it for epistemic appetite); carry whose-interest on the statement layer via gmeow:accordingTo, and keep the boundary with teleology desire by review.

Examples

  • ex:lillith gmeow:interestedIn ex:ontologyEngineering.
